tipList.name: Movement & attack
tipList.description:
During the ally phase, you can move an ally but placing the cursor on them and pressing A (K on Keyboard)

Once selected, tiles will light up in blue, red or green.
- Blue tiles are the movement tiles, where the unit can go.
- Red tiles are the attack tiles, where the unit can attack.
- Green tiles are the healing tiles, where the unit can heal.

By selecting a movement tile, the unit will walk to that tile and a new menu will appear to do an action.

ATTACK allows the unit to attack or heal, BLADES allows the unit to switch blades, COMMAND and SPECIAL are actions that will be detailed in another tip, and WAIT ends the turn of the unit.

tipList.name: Telekinesis
tipList.description:
You can toggle <size=25><sprite=12></size> telekinesis by pressing Y on Controller or O on Keyboard.

When <size=25><sprite=12></size> telekinesis is activated, the attack range is increased by 1 but damage is reduced by 25%.

When it is activated, damage depends on Psyche and Resistance instead of Attack and Defense.

tipList.name: Blades (1/3)
tipList.description:
Blades are the summoned weapons Hunters use to fight pluvials. The blade are sorted into 8 types. Each type gives different bonus in combat and when leveling up.

<size=25><sprite=0></size> Swords increase the speed and dexterity of their wielder by 2 per weapon grade.
  Growth modification : +10% str, +10% spd, -10% HP

<size=25><sprite=1> </size> Spears decrease the enemy's dexterity by 2 per weapon grade..
  Growth modification : +10% str, +10% psy, -10% res

<size=25><sprite=2></size> Greatswords decrease the enemy's defense and resistance by 1 per weapon grade while decreasing the wielder's speed by 1 per weapon grade.
  Growth modification : +10% str, +10% def, -10% spd

tipList.name: Blades (2/3)
tipList.description:
<size=25><sprite=3></size> Bows are the only physical blade by the same maximum range as a telekinesis attack (2 tiles). When used with telekinesis, they can hit a target up to 3 tiles away. However, it cannot attack in melee range (1 tile).
  Growth modification : +10% str, +10% dex, -10% def
  
<size=25><sprite=4></size> Scythes deal bonus damage to each enemy adjacent to the initial target equal to 25% of the damage they would have taken had they been attacked directly.
  Growth modification : +10% psy, +10% HP, -10% spd

<size=25><sprite=6></size> Shields increase the wielder's defense by 1 per weapon grade.
  Growth modification : +10% hp, +10% def, -10% psy

tipList.name: Blades (3/3)
tipList.description:
<size=25><sprite=7></size> Staves can heal allies (using always psyche) but their base damage is reduced by 50% during combat.
  Growth modification : +10% psy, +10% res, -10% str

<size=25><sprite=27></size> Daggers have variation in their damage, dealing randomly either 50% or 150% damage.
  Growth modification : +10% spd, +10% dex, -10% str

tipList.name: Blades Modifiers (1/4)
tipList.description:
All blade used by playable characters can have unique modifiers which change their behaviors.

  Basic : No special effect

  Sharp (all Blades) : Increases crit rate by 2% per grade but reduce hit rate by 5% per grade.

  Handy (all Blades) : Reduces crit rate by 2% per grade but increase hit rate by 5% per grade.

  Raw (all Blades) : Increase damage by 1 per grade but reduces crit rate by 2% per grade.

tipList.name: Blades Modifiers (2/4)
tipList.description:
All blade used by playable characters can have unique modifiers which change their behaviors.

  Quick (swords) : Increases the speed and dexterity bonus by 1 per grade.

  Precise (spears) : Increases dexterity reduction by 1 per grade.

  Lightweight (greatsword) : No longer lowers speed.

  Heavyweight (greatsword) : Increases the enemy's defense and resistance reduction by 1 per grade and the wielder's speed reduction by 1 per grade.

tipList.name: Blades Modifiers (3/4)
tipList.description:
All blade used by playable characters can have unique modifiers which change their behaviors.

  Farsight (bows) : Increases range by one but reduces hit rate by 20%.

  Serrated (scythe) : Increases secondary damage by 25%.

  Spiked (shield) : Increases damage dealt by half the defense of the user.

  Focused (staff) : Doubles base healing and halves durability.

  Ranged (staff) : halves base healing and increase range by 3.

tipList.name: Blades Modifiers (3/4)
tipList.description:
All blade used by playable characters can have unique modifiers which change their behaviors.

  Hidden (daggers) : Increases damage by 50% if enemy has all their HP.

  Tricky (daggers) : Changes dagger damage variation from 50%-150% to 25%-175%.

  Deadly (daggers) : Damage variation increase or decrease critical rate by 10%.

  Windborne (daggers) : Increase Dodge Rate by 5% per weapon rank.

tipList.name: Leveling up
tipList.description:
When an ally unit reaches 100 experience points, their level increase and their experience goes back to 0.

When an unit levels up, their stats can increase.

The increase is determined by their growth in each stats. A random value is picked for each stat. If this value is lower than the growth for said stat, the stat will increase by one point.

Growths can be modified by weapons and skills.

tipList.name: Fixed Growth mode
tipList.description:
Picking fixed growth mode in the options changes the way ally units level up.

Instead of picking a random value for deciding if a stat is increased, the stat is directly increased by the value (i.e. 40% growth will increase the stat by 0.4).

The true stat of the characters is the stat rounded down (1.4 will be considered as 1).

With 40% growth, the stat will increase truly after 3 levels.

Enemies and other units use Fixed Growth by default.

tipList.name: Pluvials
tipList.description:
Pluvials <size=25><sprite=10></size> are monsters created by the Beast's power.

These reanimated corpses can use blades and skills.

They get stronger under Rainy Weather and weaker under Sunny weather.

They are usually found in caves where yellow crystals appear, and outside when it starts to rain.

tipList.name: Other Units
tipList.description:
Some units are displayed in Yellow. These units are neither allies nor enemies.

They will sometimes be friendly units who need to be protected, but they can also be a third faction enemy to both allies and enemies.

tipList.name: Foresight
tipList.description:
Zack's Foresight can sometimes make him aware of the near future. 

This feature allows you to turn back time to a specific part of the current battle.

The number of time this feature can be used increases with Zack's level and some story events.

Foresight can be accessed through the neutral menu.

tipList.name: Machines
tipList.description:
Machines <size=25><sprite=11></size> are an enemy type which can usually be found in old world ruins.

These contraptions cannot use blades nor telekinesis, but the strong materials used to make them also give their weapon unlimited durability.

When they are under Sunny weather, the solar energy repairs them a bit every turn. This effect only triggers outside and never during Cloudy or Rainy weather.

tipList.name: Bonds
tipList.description:
Some characters can form Bonds together. When these characters fight together enough time, they can have a Bond Conversation at Camp.

If two characters with a high enough bond fight next to each other, they gain a bonus in hit rate, dodge rate and critical rate.

tipList.name: Skills
tipList.description:
Skills are special upgrades than can be equipped to characters. They can give passive bonuses or access to an active Command.

Each character has two innates skills that cannot be removed (some are unlocked through story progression or Side Stories), a  and 4 slots for additional skills.

Additional skills require Skill Points to equip. These Skill Points are obtained when levelling up.

tipList.name: Copying Skills
tipList.description:
The Copy Skill gives the user access to the Copy Command.

Enemies with a unique skill can be targeted by this command to obtain said skill. These enemies have a <size=25><sprite=8></size>  icon near their health bar.

Any skilled copied is temporary granted to the unit who cast the command until the end of the fight. A copied skill is show in a green box under the unit's other skills.

Each enemy can be copied only once. After copying the icon will change to <size=25><sprite=9></size> . If an enemy dies, their skill is lost.

Copying a skill grants its effets to the user until the end of the battle.

tipList.name: Elevation
tipList.description:
Each tile has a different elevation, which can influence the way battles unfold and movement.

Attacking an enemy at a higher elevation reduces dodge rate and hit rate, and the enemy gets a bonus in dodge rate and hit rate.

Moving to a higher tile also cost more movement points than moving to a lower or same elevation.

Stair tiles do not have any bonus or penalty in terms of movement or combat.

tipList.name: Special Tiles
tipList.description:
Some tiles can have special effects that can be positive or negative :

 - Forest : Increases Dodge Rate by 20%.
 - Ruins : Increases Dodge Rate by 10% and Hit Rate by 10%.
 - Fog : Increases Dodge Rate by 20% and reduces Hit Rate by 20%.
 - Fire : Reduces movement points by 1. Increases damage taken by 10% and lowers HP by 10% each turn.
 - Water : Reduces movement points by 1 and Dodge Rate by 20%.
 - Fortification : Increases Dodge Rate by 5%, Hit rate by 15% and restores 10% HP each turn.
 - Medicinal Water : Restores 50% HP each turn.
 - Desert : Lowers HP by 10% each turn.

tipList.name: Weather
tipList.description:
The influence of the Beast can sometimes unleash a blighted rain.

The rain <size=25><sprite=14></size> lasts for 2 turns and is always followed by sun <size=25><sprite=15></size>, which also lasts two turns before turning cloudy <size=25><sprite=13></size>.

A cloudy <size=25><sprite=13></size> tile has a random chance to become rainy <size=25><sprite=14></size>, which is higher if a neighboring tile is already rainy <size=25><sprite=14></size>.

Under the rain <size=25><sprite=14></size>, pluvials <size=25><sprite=10></size> get stronger. However, they also get weaker under the sun <size=25><sprite=15></size>.

Machines <size=25><sprite=11></size> use solar power to repair themselves under the sun <size=25><sprite=15></size>.

tipList.name: Battalions
tipList.description:
Now that Kira's part of the team, you can change any unit's battalion in the deployment menu and assign them to either Kira or Zack's battalion.

Each unit in Zack's battalion increases Zack's Hit and Crit rate by 1% and increases their own by 5%.

Each unit in Kira's battalion increases Kira's Psyche by 20% of the unit's Psyche and the unit recovers 10% of their HP at the beginning of each turn.

tipList.name: Boss encounters
tipList.description:
Some particularly strong enemies such as Raghnall can unleash devastating map-wide attacks. These attacks are delayed and indicated with violet tiles.

Battalion Commanders such as Kira or Zack can use the Special Command Intercept to protect their allies from the attack, reducing but 90% the damage taken by allies and by 50% the damage taken by the commander.

tipList.name: Examode
tipList.description:
After reaching certain points in the story, protagonists can enter Examode, a special state that enhances their abilities.

Examode can be triggered when the dedicated gauge is filled. This gauge fills up when the character or a character in their battalion performs an action.

Examode effect depends on the character, but it always increases the stats of all characters in the battallion by 10% while active.

tipList.name: Zack's Examode
tipList.description: Zack's Examode prevents him from going below 1 HP. It also increases the rank of all his weapons by 1, allowing him to reach rank 5 if a weapon was normally rank 4.

tipList.name: Kira's Examode
tipList.description: Kira's Examode gives all units in her battalion 50% chance to survive a fatal blow with 1 HP and increase their damage by 10%.
